_comment: Where each marketplace edition's images live, and what only that marketplace needs. The registries and IDs are the ones the marketplaces give OneUptime: replace a placeholder the moment the portal shows the real value, and record it in packages/Common/Server/Utils/Marketplace/SELF_HOSTED_RELEASING.md. Set "ready" to true only once every value of that edition is the real one: until then the Marketplace Release workflow pushes and submits nothing to that marketplace.
